hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" in *integrations/langflow/components/*|*integrations/langflow/legacy_extrct/*) echo 'Langflow scans components at startup - run: docker compose --profile prototype up -d --force-recreate langflow' ;; *packages/extrct/src/*) echo 'Library change - run the suite and the offline demo from packages/extrct before calling it done (/verify).' ;; esac
n=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then echo "$n uncommitted path(s). Consider /log then commit."; fi
